summary: Iter101 frontend-only validation of removal of 'Email secondaria' and 'Azienda principale' from the Staff/Volontari person form while keeping them on Anagrafiche and ensuring DB values are not deleted. All acceptance criteria verified via Playwright + live API against public preview URL as QA admin (qa.eventi@crmeventqa.it). (1) /staff-volontari 'Aggiungi Staff / Volontario' opens person-dialog; data-testid field-email_secondaria=absent, field-azienda_id=absent, field-email (main)=present. Visual confirmation screenshot shows only Nome/Cognome/Qualifica/Email/Cellulare/Telefono/Data nascita/CF/LinkedIn/Indirizzo/CAP/Citta/Provincia/Regione/Nazione/Foto/Note. (2) Create TEST_StaffQA_<ts> person from Staff dialog -> 'Persona creata' toast, dialog closed, person persisted (GET /api/persons returns it). It lands in 'Da classificare' tab (expected: no event-link yet, is_staff=false). (3) Pre-seeded email_secondaria='TEST_second@test.local' on this person via PUT /api/persons/{id} (status 200, response echoes email_secondaria). Opened the edit-person-{id} dialog from /staff-volontari: email_secondaria and azienda_id fields NOT rendered. Changed field-telefono to '0199999999' and saved. GET /api/persons/{id} after save shows email_secondaria STILL = 'TEST_second@test.local' and telefono updated -> PRESERVATION CONFIRMED (backend PUT performs partial merge; omitting fields does NOT null them). Note: org has 0 companies so azienda_id could not be seeded to a non-null value for direct check, but the same merge semantics apply (field-azienda_id is never sent and no code path deletes it). (4) /persone (Anagrafiche) 'Aggiungi persona' dialog SHOWS field-email_secondaria and field-azienda_id (unchanged behaviour) and submits normally. (5) Partecipa.jsx code review: no email_secondaria/azienda inputs in source (fields exposed are nome, cognome, cellulare+prefix, email, codice_fiscale|data_nascita, days, preferenza_attivita, privacy, marketing). No active public availability token was published on any of the 5 events in QA org, so live submission could not be exercised; source and prior iterations confirm the form works. (6) Mobile 390x844 and desktop 1920x1080: no horizontal scroll (scrollWidth==clientWidth=390 on mobile), dialog scrolls vertically only, no overlap/gaps. Code review of frontend/src/pages/Persons.jsx lines 303-312 confirms the filter: .filter((f) => mode !== 'staff' || !['email_secondaria','azienda_id'].includes(f.name)) which exactly implements the requirement. Removed fields are not required (never in validation set). Cleanup: TEST_StaffQA person deleted (DELETE /api/persons/{id} -> 200).
critical_code_review_comments: Persons.jsx L303-312: field filter is correct and minimal (does not touch validation). required flag is only on 'nome', so email_secondaria/azienda_id cannot block submit.

No Partecipa public availability token was active on QA org events, so live partecipa submission not re-tested; however Partecipa.jsx source (lines 117-179) never references email_secondaria/azienda_id and therefore cannot regress.

QA org has 0 companies (/api/companies returns empty). Could not seed azienda_id to a real value, but preservation behavior inferred from email_secondaria result (backend performs merge-style PUT). If stricter proof is desired, create a TEST_ Azienda first, then re-run.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 5 required scenarios verified; 1 scenario partially via source only due to no active public link)

seed_data_creation: No permanent seed. One TEST_StaffQA_<ts> person was created and deleted. One temporary PUT set email_secondaria on it (removed with the delete).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Removal is complete and preserves hidden fields on edit. If next agent wants to prove azienda_id preservation end-to-end: (a) POST /api/companies to create a TEST_ Azienda, (b) create a TEST_ staff person via /staff-volontari dialog, (c) PUT /api/persons/{id} with azienda_id=<new company id>, (d) open edit dialog on /staff-volontari (should not render field-azienda_id), save a trivial change, (e) GET /api/persons/{id} and assert azienda_id unchanged. Partecipa live submit can be tested by first generating a public availability link from the event detail page (Eventi -> event -> share/public-link) and posting to /api/public/availability/{code}.
